biological_replicate: Three adult hearts were obtained from male trauma victims aged 21–47 years with no apparent adverse heart condition (Supplementary Table 1).

experimental_design: region- and cell type-specific proteomic map of the healthy human heart
the authors present a region- and cell type-specific proteomic map of the healthy human heart, revealing functional differences and potential cell type markers.
factor_value: We selected a total of 16 anatomically defined regions from each heart for MS analysis (Fig. 1a, b)
number_of_fractions: The recently described “loss-less” nano-fractionator enabled efficient fractionation of a total of only 30 µg of peptides into eight fractions, of which a third of each fraction was loaded in the subsequent LC–MS step.
number_of_technical_replicates: To assess quantitative reproducibility, we analyzed several samples in technical triplicates.
number_of_biological_replicates: Three adult hearts were obtained from male trauma victims aged 21–47 years with no apparent adverse heart condition (Supplementary Table 1).
number_of_samples: The resulting 400 samples were analyzed with a state-of-the-art label-free workflow on a quadrupole– Orbitrap mass spectrometer (Fig. 1a).
